name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.SplitRank.nand_pair_factors
title: Separated row and column factors for a NAND gate
statement: If the inputs to a NAND gate use factor coordinates I and J, each side can locally construct one constant coordinate and all |I||J| pair products. Their GF(2) dot product encodes the Boolean NAND of the two represented bits.
